implementation: Reuse the pure rounded key only for consecutive exactly equal raw distances within one place_near invocation. No approximate equality, cross-query state, skipped candidates, changed tie ordering or refunded frontier nodes. Precision receipts count actual scalar entries; all executed retry/fallback work remains recorded.
